title: Gad workspace configuration (.gad.yaml)
description: Project configuration read by the `gad` CLI. Every value is expanded with bash-style parameter expansion; IDE layout state lives separately in .gadide.yaml.

env.description: Environment variables that seed the `env` keyword for scripts run in this workspace. Extends the process environment. Values are expanded (bash-style, e.g. ${VAR}, ${VAR:-default}); a `${.a.b}` reference reads this config. A value may be an array of path segments, joined with the OS path-list separator (portable PATH lists), e.g. GADPATH: ["a", "b"].

ide.description: Deprecated: IDE layout/state now lives in .gadide.yaml. A value here is still read when .gadide.yaml is absent (backward compatibility).
